project.name: skills-ui
project.description: TUI/WebUI wrapper for the skills CLI — OpenTUI terminal app and local/hosted web UI over an authenticated loopback HTTP API, shipped as a self-contained Bun executable.

nodes.name: api.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the authenticated loopback HTTP API server (127.0.0.1 only) exposing skill listing, detail/body lookup, registry search, install/remove/update mutations, lockfile update checks, health checks, preferences persistence, and optional WebUI HTML serving. Enforces Host allowlisting, cross-site fetch-metadata rejection, CORS and timing-safe Bearer auth for hosted cross-origin clients, token-bucket rate limiting, and a 1 MiB transport/body cap.

nodes.name: readJsonBody
nodes.summary: Reads and parses an incoming HTTP request body as a plain JSON object while enforcing the 1 MiB size limit. Throws BodyTooLarge for oversized payloads and BadJson for malformed JSON or non-object roots.

nodes.name: validSource
nodes.summary: Validates a skill source identifier at the API boundary against control characters, leading-dash argv injection, embedded HTTP credentials, and oversize strings. Accepts safe HTTP(S) URLs or compact owner/repo/ref source slugs.

nodes.name: createLimiter
nodes.summary: Creates an in-memory token-bucket rate limiter that refills continuously based on elapsed wall-clock time up to a configured capacity. Returns a predicate that consumes one token per allowed request or rejects burst storms.

nodes.name: createSkillsUiServer
nodes.summary: Starts the Bun loopback HTTP server with in-flight-deduplicated skill listing and description caches, route handlers for all /api/* endpoints and optional HTML page rendering, post-mutation hooks, and health checking. Wraps routing in Host, cross-site fetch, rate-limit, CORS preflight, and Bearer authentication gates with automatic fallback to an ephemeral port.

nodes.name: hosted-auth.ts
nodes.summary: Provides the hosted WebUI authentication and browser-boundary defense primitives for the loopback API server. Implements persisted Bearer token management, constant-time SHA-256 token verification, DNS-rebinding Host allowlisting, Sec-Fetch-Site cross-site rejection, origin allowlisting, and CORS preflight responses.

nodes.name: hostedTokenPath
nodes.summary: Resolves the filesystem path where the hosted-UI Bearer token is persisted, honoring the SKILLS_UI_PREFS_DIR environment override or defaulting to ~/.config/skills-ui/hosted-token.

nodes.name: getOrCreateHostedToken
nodes.summary: Returns the active hosted-UI Bearer token from SKILLS_UI_HOSTED_TOKEN if set, otherwise reads an existing token file or generates a 32-byte base64url secret persisted with mode 0600.

nodes.name: bearerMatches
nodes.summary: Verifies an Authorization header against the expected Bearer token in constant time by comparing SHA-256 digests with crypto.timingSafeEqual.

nodes.name: isCrossSiteFetch
nodes.summary: Detects hostile browser no-cors requests that omit the Origin header while carrying Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site, closing the non-browser exemption gap without blocking curl or address-bar navigation.

nodes.name: isAllowedHost
nodes.summary: Validates the HTTP Host header against loopback hostnames (127.0.0.1, localhost, [::1], ::1) after stripping an optional port to prevent DNS rebinding attacks.

nodes.name: isAllowedOrigin
nodes.summary: Checks whether a cross-origin request Origin matches the built-in GitHub Pages hosted UI origin, any http loopback localhost/127.0.0.1 origin, or comma-separated extras from SKILLS_UI_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

nodes.name: isSameOrigin
nodes.summary: Determines whether a request's Origin header matches its own HTTP Host header over http://, allowing embedded local WebUI calls to bypass cross-origin token checks.

nodes.name: corsHeaders
nodes.summary: Builds the Access-Control-Allow-Origin echo and Vary: Origin response headers for an allowed cross-origin client.

nodes.name: preflightResponse
nodes.summary: Constructs a 204 No Content CORS preflight response echoing the allowed origin and permitting GET, POST, PUT, OPTIONS methods along with Authorization and Content-Type headers.

nodes.name: hooks.ts
nodes.summary: Manages operator-configured post-mutation hooks (SKILLS_UI_POST_MUTATION_HOOK) and external health-check executables (SKILLS_UI_HEALTH_CMD). Spawns executables directly without a shell using a sanitized environment, enforces timeouts, scrubs output, and caches health check results with TTL and in-flight coalescing.

nodes.name: isPostMutationHookConfigured
nodes.summary: Reports whether SKILLS_UI_POST_MUTATION_HOOK is set to a non-empty executable path in the current process environment.

nodes.name: isHealthCmdConfigured
nodes.summary: Reports whether SKILLS_UI_HEALTH_CMD is set to a non-empty executable path in the current process environment.

nodes.name: spawnExecutable
nodes.summary: Spawns a configured hook or health-check executable via Bun.spawn with sanitized environment variables, captures stdout and stderr, kills the child on timeout, and returns normalized exit or spawn-error status.

nodes.name: runPostMutationHook
nodes.summary: Executes the configured post-mutation hook after install, remove, or update mutations, passing event, scope, skills, and cwd via SKILLS_UI_* environment variables. Returns a structured PostMutationHookResult with sanitized, length-clipped output.

nodes.name: createHealthChecker
nodes.summary: Creates a TTL-cached, single-flight HealthChecker that runs SKILLS_UI_HEALTH_CMD, parses optional JSON status/details payloads or falls back to sanitized text output, and supports manual refresh or cache invalidation.

nodes.name: checkHealth
nodes.summary: Convenience wrapper delegating health-check execution to the module's default shared HealthChecker instance.

nodes.name: invalidateHealthCache
nodes.summary: Clears the module's default HealthChecker cache so subsequent health checks execute the configured command fresh.

nodes.name: install.ts
nodes.summary: Wraps `skills add --yes --json` to install one, several, or all (`*`) skills from a source into project or global scope. Parses the upstream JSON result array, sanitizes all text fields at ingress, and surfaces unparseable output as a failed entry.

nodes.name: install
nodes.summary: Invokes `skills add` with `--all` or repeated `--skill` flags and optional `--global`, parses the JSON result entries, sanitizes metadata strings with sanitizeMetadata, and reports overall success only when exitCode is 0 and every entry has status installed.

nodes.name: installed.ts
nodes.summary: Lists and queries installed skills by invoking `skills ls --json [-g]`, enriching each record with lockfile- and symlink-based provenance while sanitizing display metadata at ingress and keeping filesystem paths raw.

nodes.name: classifyProvenance
nodes.summary: Determines a skill's provenance as linked (if lstatSync detects a symlink), locked (if present in the scope lockfile), or local otherwise so removal flows can warn on linked frameworks.

nodes.name: listInstalled
nodes.summary: Executes `skills ls --json` for project or global scope with a 300 s timeout, validates the JSON array payload, reads the scope lockfile defensively for provenance classification, and sanitizes all display fields.

nodes.name: findInstalled
nodes.summary: Looks up a single installed skill by exact name within the given scope by searching the output of listInstalled.

nodes.name: locks.ts
nodes.summary: Provides read-only access and per-entry schema validation for project (`skills-lock.json`) and global XDG state (`.skill-lock.json` / legacy `skills-lock.json`) lockfiles. Isolates malformed entries into per-entry diagnostics while raising InvalidLockFileError on container-level corruption.

nodes.name: InvalidLockFileError
nodes.summary: Controlled Error subclass thrown when an existing lockfile contains malformed JSON or an invalid root/skills container so API handlers can respond with 400 instead of 500.

nodes.name: normalizeLock
nodes.summary: Validates the root lockfile container and partitions individual skill entries into validated LockEntry records and per-entry diagnostic messages without discarding valid siblings or stripping forward-compatible fields.

nodes.name: projectLockPath
nodes.summary: Returns the project-scope lockfile path (`<cwd>/skills-lock.json`) for the given working directory.

nodes.name: globalLockPath
nodes.summary: Resolves the global lockfile under XDG_STATE_HOME/skills (defaulting to ~/.local/state/skills), preferring `.skill-lock.json` and falling back to legacy `skills-lock.json` only when exclusively present.

nodes.name: readLock
nodes.summary: Reads and validates the lockfile for project or global scope, returning an empty lock when the file does not exist and throwing InvalidLockFileError when an existing file has corrupt JSON or container structure.

nodes.name: remove.ts
nodes.summary: Removes installed skills via `skills rm -y [-g]` and verifies actual removal by diffing before and after installed skill lists. Accepts optional cached listing callbacks so the HTTP server avoids redundant `skills ls` spawns.

nodes.name: remove
nodes.summary: Captures the pre-removal installed set, runs `skills rm` for the requested skill names in project or global scope, re-lists installed skills via listAfter or listInstalled, and classifies each requested name as removed or missing.

nodes.name: sanitize.ts
nodes.summary: Implements CWE-150 ingress sanitization that strips ANSI CSI/C1-CSI/OSC/DCS/two-byte terminal escape sequences and unsafe control characters from untrusted CLI, lockfile, SKILL.md, and registry strings.

nodes.name: stripEscapes
nodes.summary: Removes OSC, DCS/PM/APC, 7-bit and 8-bit CSI, and simple two-byte ESC terminal sequences from an input string.

nodes.name: sanitizeMetadata
nodes.summary: Scrubs terminal escapes and C0/C1 control characters from single-line metadata fields, collapsing newlines into spaces and trimming surrounding whitespace.

nodes.name: sanitizeBody
nodes.summary: Strips terminal escape sequences and disallowed control bytes from multi-line SKILL.md bodies while preserving tabs and newlines needed for Markdown rendering.

nodes.name: search.ts
nodes.summary: Queries the skills.sh HTTP search registry with in-flight promise deduplication, ingress metadata sanitization, and progressive fallback strategies (prefix continuation fan-out and query shortening) that short-circuit cleanly on upstream HTTP failures.

nodes.name: searchRegistryFuzzyOnce
nodes.summary: Performs a single timed HTTP GET to the skills.sh /api/search endpoint, sanitizes returned skill fields, sorts hits descending by install count, and flags network or non-OK HTTP failures.

nodes.name: searchRegistryFuzzy
nodes.summary: Wraps searchRegistryFuzzyOnce with an in-flight Map keyed by query and owner so identical concurrent searches coalesce onto a single network request.

nodes.name: mapConcurrent
nodes.summary: Runs an async mapper across an array using a fixed-size worker pool (default concurrency 6) while preserving input element ordering in the output array.

nodes.name: makeSearchWithFallback
nodes.summary: Factory returning a resilient registry search function that applies hyphenated-token gating, short-circuits on primary failures, fans out alphanumeric continuations for trailing-separator prefixes, and falls back to iterative suffix shortening.

nodes.name: skill-doc.ts
nodes.summary: Reads SKILL.md files from either a direct file path or a skill directory, strips leading YAML frontmatter blocks, and sanitizes Markdown bodies at ingress for safe TUI and WebUI display.

nodes.name: readSkillDoc
nodes.summary: Attempts to read UTF-8 text from the provided path directly or from `<path>/SKILL.md`, skipping directories and returning null when neither candidate is readable.

nodes.name: stripFrontmatter
nodes.summary: Removes a leading `--- ... ---` YAML frontmatter block and trailing blank lines from a SKILL.md document string, leaving documents without valid frontmatter unchanged.

nodes.name: skillBody
nodes.summary: Loads a skill's SKILL.md document, strips YAML frontmatter, and sanitizes terminal escapes via sanitizeBody before returning the renderable Markdown body or null.

nodes.name: source.ts
nodes.summary: Discovers installable skills advertised by a remote or local source by running `skills install <source> --list --yes` with FORCE_COLOR=1 and extracting sanitized skill names from SGR cyan ANSI spans.

nodes.name: listSourceSkills
nodes.summary: Executes `skills install <source> --list --yes` with forced color output, matches cyan ANSI-delimited skill identifiers, sanitizes each captured name at ingress, and returns deduplicated SourceSkill descriptors.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines shared TypeScript domain types and data contracts across core services, the HTTP API, and the TUI, including Scope, SkillProvenance, MutationEvent, InstalledSkill, SearchSkill, AddResultEntry, UpdatesResult, PostMutationHookResult, and HealthCheckResult.

nodes.name: update.ts
nodes.summary: Wraps `skills update -p|-g -y [names]` to update installed skills in project or global scope and sanitizes the combined CLI output for UI toast display.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Runs `skills update` with explicit project (`-p`) or global (`-g`) scope and `-y` non-interactive flag over a 300 s timeout, returning success status and sanitized combined output.

nodes.name: updates-check.ts
nodes.summary: Checks locked GitHub skills for upstream updates by querying the GitHub Git Trees API per unique repo/ref and comparing folder SHAs against lockfile hashes. Treats truncated trees, malformed payloads, or missing folders in complete trees as inconclusive rather than falsely current, and isolates entry names in a null-prototype map.

nodes.name: fetchRepoTree
nodes.summary: Fetches a recursive GitHub Git Tree for a lockfile source and ref (defaulting to HEAD) with segment-wise URL encoding, optional GITHUB_TOKEN auth, and a 10 s timeout. Rejects truncated or malformed responses by returning null so incomplete trees are never treated as authoritative.

nodes.name: checkForUpdates
nodes.summary: Reads the scope lockfile, carries forward per-entry lock diagnostics, batches GitHub entries by repository and ref, compares each skill folder SHA against the complete upstream tree, and reports explicit error reasons for uncheckable, failed, or missing-folder entries.

nodes.name: skills-client.ts
nodes.summary: Central subprocess boundary for executing the upstream `skills` CLI executable via Bun.spawn. Applies an allowlist/denylist environment sanitizer, caches executable resolution, serializes invocations behind a bounded spawn queue, enforces timeouts, and parses `skills --version`.

nodes.name: SkillsCliError
nodes.summary: Error subclass thrown when the `skills` CLI executable cannot be spawned or returns unexpected version output.

nodes.name: sanitizeEnv
nodes.summary: Filters a process environment map down to an explicit allowlist of safe variables and prefixes (such as PATH, HOME, SKILLS_*, XDG_*, GIT_*, proxy vars) while explicitly stripping hook and health-command env vars.

nodes.name: resolveSkillsBin
nodes.summary: Resolves and caches the `skills` CLI executable path from SKILLS_UI_SKILLS_BIN or falls back to `skills` on PATH.

nodes.name: resetSkillsBinCache
nodes.summary: Clears the cached `skills` executable path so tests or runtime environment updates trigger fresh binary resolution.

nodes.name: runSkills
nodes.summary: Queues a `skills` CLI invocation through the module's serialized spawn queue so only one child process runs at a time and excess bursts fail fast with SkillsBusyError.

nodes.name: runSkillsUnqueued
nodes.summary: Spawns the resolved `skills` CLI directly with sanitized environment variables, NO_COLOR/FORCE_COLOR handling, and a kill timer, returning captured stdout, stderr, combined text, and exit code.

nodes.name: skillsVersion
nodes.summary: Runs `skills --version` with a 10 s timeout and validates that stdout starts with a semantic version string, throwing SkillsCliError on malformed output.

nodes.name: spawn-queue.ts
nodes.summary: Implements a bounded FIFO concurrency semaphore for `skills` CLI subprocesses so request bursts cannot fan out long-running child processes. Rejects excess waiters immediately with SkillsBusyError when the queue reaches SKILLS_UI_SPAWN_QUEUE_CAP.

nodes.name: SkillsBusyError
nodes.summary: Error subclass raised when the subprocess spawn queue is at capacity so the HTTP API can return a 503 Service Unavailable response instead of queuing unbounded work.

nodes.name: queueCap
nodes.summary: Reads SKILLS_UI_SPAWN_QUEUE_CAP as a non-negative integer queue capacity limit, falling back to the default cap of 8 when unset or invalid.

nodes.name: createSpawnQueue
nodes.summary: Creates a FIFO async semaphore with configurable max concurrency (default 1) that schedules tasks as slots free, rejects overflow callers with SkillsBusyError, and exposes live running and queued counts.

nodes.name: hosted-auth.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit and API integration test suite verifying hosted-auth token persistence, environment overrides, Host and Origin allowlists, same-origin checks, CORS preflight behavior, token-free /api/version probes, and 401/403 enforcement on createSkillsUiServer.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Test harness helper that dynamically imports createSkillsUiServer and webPageRenderer, launches an ephemeral loopback server capturing its issued Bearer token, and registers cleanup for afterEach.

nodes.name: locks.test.ts
nodes.summary: Regression test suite covering CORE-03 per-entry lockfile validation, controlled InvalidLockFileError 400 responses on GET /api/updates, __proto__ key safety, and CORE-04 inconclusive handling for truncated or incomplete GitHub tree responses.

nodes.name: sanitize.test.ts
nodes.summary: Security test suite verifying ANSI/C1 escape stripping and control-character scrubbing in sanitize.ts as well as end-to-end ingress sanitization across listInstalled, listSourceSkills, install, and HTTP API skill descriptions and SKILL.md bodies.

nodes.name: serve-hardening.test.ts
nodes.summary: Hostile-input hardening test suite covering timing-safe bearerMatches, spawn-queue backpressure, fetchRepoTree URL encoding and completeness checks, cross-site Sec-Fetch-Site rejection, API argv/shape validation, transport body caps, rate limiting, and slow-handler idle timeouts.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Test helper that starts an ephemeral createSkillsUiServer instance with configurable rate-limit options and tracks it for automatic teardown.

nodes.name: disk-index.ts
nodes.summary: Persists a per-scope stale-while-revalidate cache of enriched installed skills under the user cache directory so TUI sessions paint immediately before subprocess refreshes settle. Partitions project-scope caches by canonical realpath hash and envelope projectRoot, rejects corrupt or oversized files safely, and writes atomically with stale temp/project sweeps.

nodes.name: sweepStaleTmp
nodes.summary: Best-effort cleanup that deletes abandoned per-PID temporary index files older than TMP_SWEEP_MIN_AGE_MS matching the given filename prefix.

nodes.name: sweepStaleProjectIndexes
nodes.summary: Best-effort bounded-growth sweep that removes untouched hash-suffixed project index files older than 30 days while keeping the active project file and global cache intact.

nodes.name: diskIndexDir
nodes.summary: Resolves the disk-index cache directory, honoring SKILLS_UI_CACHE_DIR or an explicit dirOverride before falling back to ~/.cache/skills-ui.

nodes.name: projectIdentity
nodes.summary: Returns the canonical realpath of the current working directory so symlink aliases resolve to one consistent project cache identity.

nodes.name: diskIndexPath
nodes.summary: Computes the persisted index file path for a scope, appending a 16-hex SHA-256 hash of projectIdentity for project scope while keeping global scope unsuffixed.

nodes.name: normalizeEntry
nodes.summary: Validates and sanitizes a single untrusted persisted JSON record into an InstalledSkill matching the requested scope, returning null on invalid or mismatched fields.

nodes.name: normalizeDiskIndex
nodes.summary: Parses raw JSON index content, enforces schema version 2, scope match, and canonical projectRoot partition checks, and drops invalid skill entries.

nodes.name: loadDiskIndex
nodes.summary: Loads and validates the persisted disk index for a scope after checking existence and the 16 MB size ceiling, returning null instead of throwing on any failure.

nodes.name: saveDiskIndex
nodes.summary: Atomically persists a fresh subprocess-verified skill list to disk via a per-PID temp file and rename after running stale-temp and stale-project-index sweeps.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel entrypoint that re-exports core skill types, filter matching, CLI runner utilities, installed/search/mutation services, lock-file helpers, update checks, and post-mutation hook and health check APIs. Provides a single import surface for the TUI, HTTP API, and test suites.

nodes.name: prefs.ts
nodes.summary: Manages persisted UI preferences (Catppuccin theme, sound effects, reduced motion, fixed web port, and list-pane width percentage) under the skills-ui config directory. Normalizes partial or legacy preference files safely and supports one-time migration from the upstream skills CLI preference file.

nodes.name: uiPrefsPath
nodes.summary: Resolves the skills-ui preferences JSON path, respecting SKILLS_UI_PREFS_DIR, an explicit dirOverride, or XDG_CONFIG_HOME / ~/.config/skills-ui.

nodes.name: normalizePreferences
nodes.summary: Merges recognized theme, sound, reduceMotion, port, and listWidth fields from untrusted input onto DEFAULT_UI_PREFERENCES, migrating legacy pixel listWidth values cleanly to null.

nodes.name: loadUiPreferences
nodes.summary: Reads and normalizes persisted UI preferences from disk, falling back silently to DEFAULT_UI_PREFERENCES when the file is missing or corrupt.

nodes.name: saveUiPreferences
nodes.summary: Creates the parent directory if needed and writes formatted UI preferences JSON to disk.

nodes.name: importSkillsPrefsOnce
nodes.summary: Performs a one-time read-only copy of the upstream skills CLI ui-prefs.json when skills-ui has no preferences file yet, returning true only when imported.

nodes.name: seed.ts
nodes.summary: Parses CLI command-line arguments into structured UiSeed intents for launching the TUI or Web UI pre-seeded with add, update, or remove actions. Performs flag-aware positional extraction so value-taking options do not pollute skill or source arguments.

nodes.name: positionals
nodes.summary: Extracts bare positional arguments from a CLI argument slice while skipping known value-taking flags and their following option values.

nodes.name: flagValues
nodes.summary: Collects all consecutive non-flag tokens supplied after occurrences of a specified CLI flag such as --skill.

nodes.name: parseUiSeed
nodes.summary: Maps raw CLI argv tokens into a typed UiSeed discriminated union (add, update, remove, or none) for pre-seeding UI flows.

nodes.name: theme.ts
nodes.summary: Defines Catppuccin Mocha and Latte color palettes, WCAG 2.x luminance and contrast utilities, contrast-enforced semantic theme tokens, truecolor/256-color ANSI terminal painters, and OpenTUI tree-sitter syntax highlighting scopes. Serves as the single color token source for both TUI and web surfaces.

nodes.name: hexToRgb
nodes.summary: Converts a 6-digit hex color string (with or without leading #) into an [r, g, b] byte tuple.

nodes.name: relativeLuminance
nodes.summary: Computes WCAG 2.x relative luminance (0 to 1) for a hex color using sRGB linearization coefficients.

nodes.name: contrastRatio
nodes.summary: Calculates the WCAG 2.x contrast ratio between foreground and background hex colors in the range 1 to 21.

nodes.name: darkenToContrast
nodes.summary: Iteratively darkens a hex color until its contrast ratio against a light background meets the requested WCAG minimum threshold.

nodes.name: buildThemeTokens
nodes.summary: Derives the full WCAG-checked ThemeTokens map from a Catppuccin palette, darkening Latte foregrounds and borders as needed to satisfy AA text and UI contrast minimums.

nodes.name: tokensFor
nodes.summary: Returns the precomputed semantic ThemeTokens record for the requested Catppuccin theme name (mocha or latte).

nodes.name: createAnsiPainter
nodes.summary: Creates an AnsiPainter helper that wraps strings in 24-bit truecolor or nearest 256-color ANSI escape sequences for foreground, background, bold, and dim styling.

nodes.name: syntaxTokensFor
nodes.summary: Maps a Catppuccin palette into OpenTUI tree-sitter markdown and code highlight scope styles for headings, keywords, strings, comments, links, and punctuation.

nodes.name: Views.tsx
nodes.summary: Implements the OpenTUI React view tree mounted on a single root and subscribed to the Elm-style TuiModel store via useSyncExternalStore. Renders the startup splash, optional 3D skill graph, installed and registry-search split panes with match highlighting, settings panel, constant footer legend, and animated modal overlays.

nodes.name: useApp
nodes.summary: React hook that reads the AppBridge context providing store subscription, state access, dispatch, and shared renderable refs.

nodes.name: mountApp
nodes.summary: Mounts the root React App component inside AppProvider on an OpenTUI CliRenderer and returns an unmount teardown callback.

nodes.name: usePopInOverlay
nodes.summary: Animates modal overlay vertical slide-in on mount using OpenTUI's timeline engine, skipping motion immediately when reduceMotion is enabled.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Top-level React TUI shell subscribed to TuiModel that switches between the startup Splash screen and the main Header/Body/Footer layout with active modal overlays.

nodes.name: Splash
nodes.summary: Renders the full-screen startup splash view with the procedural gradient banner image, application title, and initial loading status.

nodes.name: GraphView
nodes.summary: Dynamically loads three-scene.ts to mount an interactive 3D ThreeRenderable skill graph with timeline-driven slow rotation and graceful fallback messaging when WebGPU is unavailable.

nodes.name: Header
nodes.summary: Renders the top navigation header bar displaying app version, active tab indicators, project/global scope badge, and conditional health status pill.

nodes.name: checkedTitle
nodes.summary: Formats the compact installed-pane border title carrying the checked count while staying within the 19-character narrow-pane budget via graceful degradation.

nodes.name: installedListTitle
nodes.summary: Builds the installed skill list pane border title incorporating checked counts, active sort mode, provenance/agent filter tags, and list width percentage.

nodes.name: searchListTitle
nodes.summary: Builds the registry search results pane border title showing result count, search sort mode, queued count, and active pane focus.

nodes.name: useSelectionScrollFollow
nodes.summary: React hook that keeps the currently selected row visible inside an OpenTUI ScrollBoxRenderable by computing relative row offsets with an index-based fallback.

nodes.name: skillRowStyle
nodes.summary: Computes foreground, background, text attributes, and provenance tag colors for an installed skill row based on selection, check state, and provenance kind.

nodes.name: InstalledSkillRow
nodes.summary: Renders a single selectable installed skill list item showing check glyph, skill name, provenance badge, update arrow, and agent count.

nodes.name: InstalledDetailPane
nodes.summary: Renders the right-hand installed skill detail panel with metadata header, update or error notices, and tree-sitter highlighted SKILL.md markdown content.

nodes.name: InstalledBody
nodes.summary: Renders the Installed tab's permanent filter input bar and resizable two-pane split connecting InstalledSkillRow scrolling with InstalledDetailPane.

nodes.name: highlightSegments
nodes.summary: Splits a text string into case-insensitive matched and unmatched runs for every search query token so views can highlight hits accurately.

nodes.name: HighlightedRuns
nodes.summary: Renders styled text spans from highlightSegments, emphasizing matched query tokens while respecting row selection contrast.

nodes.name: SearchResultRow
nodes.summary: Renders a single registry search result row with its procedural source identicon badge, queue checkbox, highlighted skill name/source, and install count.

nodes.name: SearchQueueSection
nodes.summary: Renders the collapsible install-queue sub-pane beneath search results so users can inspect and remove queued skills before batch installation.

nodes.name: SearchRepoSkillsList
nodes.summary: Renders the list of sibling skills discovered inside the currently selected search result's source repository, highlighting the selected skill.

nodes.name: SearchDetailPane
nodes.summary: Renders the right-hand search detail panel displaying source metadata, install telemetry, fallback query notices, and sibling repository skills.

nodes.name: SearchBody
nodes.summary: Renders the Search tab's query input bar, failure or fallback banners, two-pane results/detail layout, and queued-installs sub-section.

nodes.name: SettingsBody
nodes.summary: Renders the Settings tab displaying interactive Catppuccin theme, sound, reduced-motion, and list-width preferences alongside the discovered skills CLI version.

nodes.name: Footer
nodes.summary: Renders the fixed bottom status bar displaying active busy indicators, FIFO toast notifications, quit-arm warnings, and the context-sensitive keybinding legend.

nodes.name: HelpOverlay
nodes.summary: Renders the animated modal keybinding reference overlay toggled with ?, summarizing navigation, batch selection, search, and settings shortcuts.

nodes.name: AgentSelectOverlay
nodes.summary: Renders the animated agent-filter modal allowing users to stage, toggle-all, and apply multi-agent filter selections.

nodes.name: HealthOverlay
nodes.summary: Renders the animated health-check status overlay showing command summary, exit status, timestamp, and truncated diagnostics with refresh hints.

nodes.name: ConfirmOverlay
nodes.summary: Renders the animated confirmation modal for destructive remove or update actions, surfacing provenance warnings for non-locked skills.

nodes.name: app.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the interactive OpenTUI application lifecycle, wiring the pure Elm-style TuiModel store, React view mounting, keyboard dispatch, stale-while-revalidate disk-index hydration, async search/update/mutation workflows, crash-guard signal cleanup, and injectable production dependencies. Re-exports spike screen helpers for selftest verification.

nodes.name: installCrashGuard
nodes.summary: Registers idempotent process signal (SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP) and fatal error (uncaughtException/unhandledRejection) handlers that restore the terminal before exiting, returning a dispose handle.

nodes.name: runTui
nodes.summary: Entry point for live terminal sessions that checks TTY availability, creates the OpenTUI CLI renderer, installs the crash guard, runs runTuiOn, and disposes audio and guards on exit.

nodes.name: runTuiOn
nodes.summary: Mounts the full interactive TUI onto any real or test CliRenderer, wiring store dispatch, FIFO toast timers, SWR disk-index loading and reconciliation, debounced search, scope-guarded update checks, mutations with post-mutation hooks, and keyboard routing.

nodes.name: art.ts
nodes.summary: Generates procedural RGBA pixel art via OpenTUI NativeImage for the startup splash gradient banner and deterministic per-source search identicon badges. Caches generated images per theme and source key so the standalone binary ships zero external image assets.

nodes.name: splashImage
nodes.summary: Procedurally renders and caches a 96x28 RGBA diagonal gradient NativeImage through the active Catppuccin theme's mauve, sapphire, and teal accents with feathered side alpha.

nodes.name: sourceBadge
nodes.summary: Generates and caches a deterministic 4x2 RGBA two-color identicon NativeImage per source string and Catppuccin theme using an FNV-1a 32-bit hash.

nodes.name: audio.ts
nodes.summary: Synthesizes short mono f32le PCM sine-wave UI feedback tones (select, confirm, success, error) streamed through OpenTUI's Audio engine. Gates playback on user sound preferences, disposes resources cleanly on exit, and degrades silently when audio hardware is unavailable.

nodes.name: ensure
nodes.summary: Lazily imports OpenTUI's Audio engine, starts a singleton Audio instance, and latches a failure flag on error so subsequent calls degrade silently without retrying.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with README.md, CONTEXT.md, and package.json to understand what skills-ui is and the vocabulary shared across its codebase. skills-ui wraps the upstream skills CLI as a standalone Bun executable offering three runtime modes—OpenTUI terminal app, local --web UI, and headless serve API—plus a hosted zero-install page. CONTEXT.md locks down canonical terms like Frame, Filter List Panel, Detail Panel, Skill Provenance, and Health Pill so both UI surfaces stay aligned, while package.json pins the Bun >=1.4 runtime, OpenTUI, and React 19 stack.

tour.title: Entry Point & Mode Dispatch
tour.description: With the project goals in mind, trace how execution begins in src/main.ts. This primary CLI entrypoint parses shared flags like --port and routes execution to --version, --selftest, headless serve, --web browser mode, or the default OpenTUI terminal interface. Supporting it at startup, version.ts provides a single APP_VERSION source of truth across compiled and dev runs, while seed.ts parses flag-aware positional CLI arguments into structured UiSeed intents for pre-seeded install, update, or remove flows.
tour.languageLesson: Bun's build-time --define option lets version.ts inline __APP_VERSION__ directly into single-file compiled binaries while falling back to package.json during local development. Strict ESM with TypeScript's verbatimModuleSyntax keeps type-only imports erased cleanly at compile time.

tour.title: Subprocess Boundary & Sanitization
tour.description: Because skills-ui never bundles or imports upstream skills code, every CLI operation crosses the hardened boundary in skills-client.ts via Bun.spawn with allowlist/denylist environment scrubbing and cached binary discovery. To prevent bursty UI or HTTP traffic from spawning runaway child processes, spawn-queue.ts serializes invocations behind a bounded FIFO semaphore that fast-fails with SkillsBusyError on saturation. All untrusted strings arriving from CLI output, lockfiles, and SKILL.md files pass through sanitize.ts (CWE-150 ANSI/C1/OSC/DCS escape stripping) before conforming to the shared domain contracts in types.ts.
tour.languageLesson: TypeScript literal unions and structured interface contracts in types.ts (such as Scope, SkillProvenance, and MutationEvent) act as a compile-time protocol between core services, HTTP handlers, and UI renderers, catching mismatched states before runtime.

tour.title: Domain Services & Provenance
tour.description: Building on the subprocess runner and types from Step 3, src/core/index.ts exposes the cohesive domain services consumed by both the HTTP API and the TUI. installed.ts runs skills ls --json and enriches each skill with lockfile- and symlink-based provenance, while locks.ts validates project and global XDG lockfiles per entry so a single malformed record produces diagnostics without breaking valid entries. For remote discovery and maintenance, search.ts queries the skills.sh registry with in-flight promise deduplication and progressive fallbacks, and updates-check.ts compares GitHub Git Trees SHAs conservatively—marking truncated or incomplete trees inconclusive rather than falsely current.

tour.title: Caching, Preferences & Hooks
tour.description: Upstream skills ls scans can take tens of seconds on large home directories, so this layer shields users from cold-start latency and unifies cross-surface behavior. disk-index.ts persists atomic, realpath-partitioned stale-while-revalidate caches so TUI sessions paint in under a millisecond while fresh data loads behind the scenes. prefs.ts, theme.ts, and filter.ts share Catppuccin Mocha/Latte WCAG-verified tokens, persisted user settings, and the exact substring filter predicate across both terminal and browser UIs, while hooks.ts runs shell-free post-mutation hooks and TTL-cached external health checks.

tour.title: Loopback HTTP API & Auth
tour.description: When launched in serve or --web mode from Step 2, src/core/api.ts exposes the core services over a 127.0.0.1-only HTTP API with per-scope list caching, concurrent read coalescing, token-bucket rate limiting, and a 1 MiB body cap. Mutation endpoints coordinate install.ts and remove.ts while invalidating cached listings and triggering post-mutation hooks cleanly. Because the hosted GitHub Pages UI talks to this local server cross-origin, hosted-auth.ts enforces browser-boundary defenses including DNS-rebinding Host allowlists, Sec-Fetch-Site rejection, CORS preflights, and constant-time SHA-256 Bearer token verification.

tour.title: OpenTUI Model & Lifecycle
tour.description: In default terminal mode, src/tui/app.ts orchestrates the interactive OpenTUI lifecycle by wiring keyboard dispatch, disk-index hydration, async search and mutation workflows, and crash-guard signal cleanup. Rather than scattering state across components, model.ts implements a pure Elm-style reducer that tracks scope-keyed updates, sort modes, install queues, and modals while memoizing one filter-and-sort pass per dispatch. Views.tsx subscribes a single React root to that store to render split panes and overlays, and spike.ts provides the tree-sitter Markdown spike screen verified by --selftest.
tour.languageLesson: Combining a pure Elm-style state reducer (model.ts) with React's useSyncExternalStore inside OpenTUI (Views.tsx) separates business logic from terminal rendering, enabling deterministic in-memory tests of keyboard contracts and async race guards without a real TTY.

tour.title: Procedural Art, Audio & 3D
tour.description: To keep the compiled executable self-contained with zero bundled media files, the TUI synthesizes its rich graphics and sound effects on demand. art.ts generates cached RGBA pixel banners and deterministic per-source identicon badges through OpenTUI NativeImage, while audio.ts streams short mono f32le PCM sine-wave cues gated on user preferences and degrades silently when hardware is absent. When users toggle the 3D skill graph, Views.tsx dynamically imports three-scene.ts to lay out skills on a Fibonacci sphere with @opentui/three so terminals without WebGPU pay zero startup cost.

tour.title: Single-File Web UI
tour.description: The Web UI uses a zero-bundler architecture centered on src/web/page.ts—the highest fan-in module in the graph—which renders one self-contained HTML document served locally by api.ts and exported statically for GitHub Pages. styles.ts supplies Catppuccin CSS variables and responsive layout rules, while client/core.ts handles authenticated loopback fetches, sessionStorage token persistence, health popovers, and Web Audio cues. client/installed.ts embeds filter.ts's skillMatches source verbatim, reconciles keyed DOM rows without replay flicker, and renders escape-first Markdown details, while client/search-and-boot.ts drives registry search, install queueing, and keyboard shortcuts.
tour.languageLesson: Assembling browser JavaScript from TypeScript string modules with SHA-256 hash-pinned Content-Security-Policy headers and </script>-escaped JSON bootstrap blocks removes frontend build complexity while defending against inline XSS injection.

tour.title: Cross-Platform Build & Installer
tour.description: Turning the TypeScript codebase into distributable artifacts starts in scripts/build.ts, which invokes bun build --compile across darwin-arm64, darwin-x64, linux-x64, and linux-arm64 with embedded __APP_VERSION__, macOS JIT entitlements codesigning, and a SHA-256 checksum manifest. verify-build-targets.ts confirms each binary's Mach-O/ELF architecture and digest, while export-page.ts emits docs/app.html from Step 9's renderer for GitHub Pages. On user machines, scripts/install.sh detects OS and CPU architecture, verifies the downloaded binary against the tag-committed checksum manifest, and installs it atomically—all orchestrated by the release checklist in docs/release.md.

tour.title: Testing, Perf Budgets & CI
tour.description: Every architectural guarantee in previous steps is continuously pinned by dedicated harnesses, shims, and GitHub Actions workflows. tests/fixtures/skills-shim.mjs emulates the upstream skills CLI statefully with JSONL call logs and configurable partial failures so unit, API, and Playwright tests run hermetically and count exact subprocess spawns. scripts/perf/budget.ts enforces latency and DOM-reconciliation budgets, scripts/pty-smoke/smoke.py drives real pseudo-terminal TUI sessions via Python and pyte, and the two GitHub Actions workflows automate pull request code reviews and @claude issue assistance.
tour.languageLesson: GitHub Actions YAML workflows combine explicit event triggers (on: pull_request, issue_comment) with minimal permissions blocks and pinned action versions (anthropics/claude-code-action@v1) to keep repository automation reproducible and least-privileged.
